Silverwing Sentinels are the Alliance faction for the Warsong Gulch battleground. The night elves, who have begun a massive push to retake the forests of Ashenvale, are now focusing their attention on ridding their land of the Warsong Outriders once and for all. And so, the Silverwing Sentinels have answered the call and sworn that they will not rest until every last orc is defeated and cast out of Warsong Gulch. The sentinels fought against the Horde during their first invasion of Ashenvale.
Silverwing Hold is the Silverwing Sentinels base in Warsong Gulch. The Alliance night elves fight to protect their forests from the Horde, who have a base in the nearby Warsong Lumber Mill.

Silverwing Grove is the Silverwing Sentinels base. It is located in south-central Ashenvale, southwest of Silverwing Outpost and west of Fallen Sky Lake. It is the location of the entrance to the Warsong Gulch battleground, and holds several PvP-aligned NPCs, including an Alliance Brigadier General, a pair of vendors, and another PvP quest giver named Sentinel Farsong. During the War of the Thorns, the grove was attacked by the Horde.

Sin and Punishment is a Tier 6 Shadow priest talent. When your Vampiric Touch is dispelled, there is a 50/100% chance for the dispeller and all nearby enemy targets within 6 yards to be feared in horror for 3 seconds. It also causes reduces your Shadowfiend cooldown to be reduced by 5/10 seconds each time your Mind Flay crits.

:Diamonds! Stranglethorn Vale's Silvershard mines are full of the gleaming gems, and, while they’re pretty to look at, they’re far more important for what they can buy: new blades, ballistae and battle-gear for the soldiers of the Alliance and Horde. Neither faction wants its opposition digging up diamonds – not when the other option is to spill their enemies' blood on the rocks and make off with the loot in Venture co. mine carts! Silvershard Mines is a 10vs10 resource race battleground set in Stranglethorn Vale and introduced in Mists of Pandaria. The objective of the battleground is to be the first to generate 1600 resources through controlling and capturing mine carts.
